name: Langry RH450-A High-Strength Concrete Test Hammer
short_description: High impact energy (4.500 J) test hammer engineered specifically for testing high-strength concrete elements (60 to 100 MPa) in tall buildings and mega bridges.
description: The **Langry RH450-A High-Strength Concrete Test Hammer** is designed to overcome saturation issues encountered when standard 2.207 J hammers test concrete above 60 MPa. With a rated impact energy of 4.5 Joules, it accurately measures compressive strengths up to 100 MPa in high-rise building pillars, pre-stressed highway girders, and heavy infrastructure projects.

key_features.feature: Elevated nominal impact energy of 4.500 Joules for high-strength concrete
Linear measuring range from 60 to 100 MPa compressive strength
Heavy-duty hardened alloy construction resistant to jobsite wear
Special impact spring with 900 ± 40 N/m stiffness
Calibrated against certified high-energy steel test anvils (88 ± 2)
